Class ThreadListTest

java.lang.Object
tests.ThreadListTest
class ThreadListTest extends Object

Title: ThreadListTest

Description: Tests for in-memory ThreadList read-only lookups and for PostReplyValidator.checkForValidThread(String, ThreadList).

Thread CRUD business logic (create, update, delete with guards) is tested at the Database layer in DatabaseTest, following this project's convention that all business logic lives in Database. This class covers only the container operations (addThread, getThreadByName, getThreadByID, threadExists) and the validator that takes a live ThreadList.

No database required — all tests use in-memory objects.
